brief.headline: Priority alert: possible shelf sweep on the aisle camera.
observed: At 3.0 s: An item was taken from the shelf.
At 4.2 s: Item in the right hand was last seen away from the body; no basket, shelf or scan event explains it.
At 5.2 s: Item in the left hand was last seen at a personal bag; no basket, shelf or scan event explains it.
At 8.8 s: Item in the left hand was last seen at a personal bag; no basket, shelf or scan event explains it.
Fastest gap between picks was 0.8; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is 12.8 (range 1 to 12.8).
benign_explanations: A colleague is rotating or removing stock.
A customer is buying in bulk and loading a trolley.
A shelf sensor fault produced repeated removal events.
brief.recommended_action: Alert the duty manager and security now. Keep a safe distance and do not approach. Preserve footage of the aisle and the exit for the evidence pack.
brief.confidence_note: Model risk is 1.00, which is strong evidence for this scenario. Pose tracking was clear throughout the clip.
